insight.text: The model learns to remove noise step by step; your description guides every step.

detail.text: Technical name: diffusion. While learning, the AI sees huge numbers of images sprinkled with noise and practices guessing the noise so it can remove it.

insight.text: Many new image AIs live inside chatbots: they follow long prompts, render text better, and edit part by part via chat.

detail.text: These are called natively multimodal models: one brain that both reads text and draws images. Examples: GPT Image 2, Nano Banana 2.

concepts.label: Ten concept stones
concepts.idle: Each stone is a button you’ll come across

items.name: Text to image
items.say: Type a description; AI paints a brand-new image from scratch.

items.name: Image to image
items.say: Give it a base image; AI repaints it the way you ask.

items.name: Fix one area
items.say: Circle an area; AI repaints just that spot.

items.name: Extend the frame
items.say: AI keeps painting past the edges, widening the frame.

items.name: Sharpen & enlarge
items.say: Raises resolution: a bigger image that stays sharp.

items.name: Reference image
items.say: Give a sample image so AI follows its style, colors and layout.

items.name: Consistent character
items.say: Keeps the same face and outfit across many different images.

items.name: Seed
items.say: The code for the starting noise: same seed, same words, a near-identical image.

items.name: Aspect ratio
items.say: Square, landscape or portrait: choose first, and AI composes to fit.

items.name: Negative prompt
items.say: Spell out what you don’t want: stray text, blur, warped hands.

concepts.insight: Each tool names them a little differently, but know these ten buttons and most tools will feel less strange.

detail.text: The strengths listed here are general assessments as of Oct 12, 2026; AI changes week by week.
